meta.title: Verified official sources for Lamahatta GP audit
meta.rule: These are portals to look up — not proof of village delivery. Proof only after a row lands in infrastructure-audit.json or gov-works.json with source + as_of.
meta.privacy: No person names. Public-safe entry points only.

sources.name: Local Government Directory (LGD)
sources.notes: Offline statewide dumps in data_from_the_internet/; extract lives in lgd-identity.json.

sources.name: eGramSwaraj
sources.scope_key: Search Gram Panchayat Lamahatta / LGD 261054 — works, GPDP, expenditure, assets
sources.notes: Primary portal for GP works status, abandoned/held-up, and asset directory. Manual capture into gov-works.json first.

sources.name: Meri Panchayat
sources.system: Ministry of Panchayati Raj · Meri Panchayat
sources.notes: Citizen-facing GP information surface. Cross-check with eGramSwaraj.

sources.name: Jal Jeevan Mission / e-Jal Shakti
sources.system: Department of Drinking Water & Sanitation · JJM
sources.scope_key: West Bengal · Darjeeling · Rangli Rangliot · Lamahatta / habitation for Sunaray (Simana) Gaon
sources.notes: FHTC coverage and habitation-level claims. Portal claim ≠ ground taps until verified.

sources.name: Open Government Data (data.gov.in)
sources.system: National Data Sharing and Accessibility Policy · data.gov.in
sources.scope_key: Search JJM, BharatNet, Gram Panchayat, rural schemes datasets for WB / Darjeeling
sources.notes: Prefer official downloads over brittle HTML scrapes. Cache with fetched_at.

sources.name: BharatNet / BBNL
sources.scope_key: West Bengal · Darjeeling · GP service-ready / OFC status near Lamahatta
sources.notes: Broadband infrastructure claims. Pair with ground signal checks.

sources.name: PMGSY OMMS
sources.system: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana · Online Management Monitoring System
sources.scope_key: West Bengal · Darjeeling · packages serving Rangli Rangliot / Lamahatta access
sources.notes: Road package IDs, length, completion status. Record IDs in gov-works.json.

sources.name: MGNREGA MIS
sources.scope_key: West Bengal · Darjeeling · Rangli Rangliot · Lamahatta GP — job cards, person-days (no Aadhaar on public site)
sources.notes: Publish coverage % and person-days, never worker Aadhaar.

sources.name: Department of Telecommunications
sources.scope_key: Coverage programmes / tower policy relevant to Darjeeling hills
sources.notes: Policy and programme entry; not a household signal meter.

sources.name: PM-WANI
sources.scope_key: Public Wi-Fi PDOs near Lamahatta / Rangli Rangliot if any

sources.name: Right to Information Act, 2005
sources.system: Citizen statutory right · RTI Act 2005 (esp. §4 proactive disclosure + §6 applications)
sources.scope_key: PIO Lamahatta Gram Panchayat LGD 261054; copy BDO Rangli Rangliot
sources.notes: Citizens have a right to know what the panchayat does: works, minutes, water lists, assets. Tracker: rti-filings.json + /rti.

sources.name: Sunaray Gaon household survey 2026
sources.system: Village-owned ground survey (aggregates only on public site)
sources.notes: Source for functional_taps=0 and demography rates. Person names never public.
